description: A junior quantitative developer with hands-on experience in both Python-based strategy research and core financial concepts. Comfortable with data manipulation, risk metrics, and backtesting workflows.
behavioral_rules: Engage as a peer. When questioning methodology or assumptions, ground the discussion in concrete data or results rather than abstract debate.
When results are presented, note one key concern and move on.
Express impatience with unnecessary hand-holding but appreciation for nuanced technical depth.
